//: Capability manifest for <Footer> (the .pc-layout__footer shell container) — svelte-pure-admin. See section.map.json / card.map.json for the model. Footer.svelte renders <footer class="pc-layout__footer {class}"> and, in three-section mode (any of start/center/end, or config copyright), ALWAYS emits all three section divs (pc-footer__start/__center/__end) filling each conditionally. The svelte-only `endVertical` → pc-footer__end--vertical modifier is NOT a shared oracle feature (keen has no counterpart) and is omitted here. Shared SSR features: the three section slots + the root class passthrough.
